topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I never expected to see it again, that delicate band with the small, sparkling diamond. It had been my grandmother’s engagement ring, a family heirloom that was always meant to stay within our bloodline. The shop was dim, the kind of place where memories are lost and stories are forgotten, and there it was, perched on a worn velvet cushion, as if waiting for someone to remember. I traced the outline of the ring with my finger, feeling the weight of the past in my touch. It seemed so small, yet it carried the weight of all the years that had slipped away. I wondered how it ended up here, how it was separated from the hands that once promised to hold it forever.
